title: Embracing Contradiction: Theoretical Inconsistency Will Not Impede the Road of Building Responsible AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the theoretical and practical implications of inconsistent metrics in Responsible AI, such as fairness and privacy, arguing that they should be embraced rather than eliminated.
